decisive_items: bilateral adrenal and periaortic retroperitoneal masses
sparse perivascular and interstitial infiltrate of enlarged atypical mononuclear cells
response.rationale: Only candidate R3 was supplied. The biopsy finding of enlarged atypical mononuclear cells in the dermis and subcutis, together with retroperitoneal and adrenal masses and failure to improve on antibiotics, strongly supports a lymphoproliferative disorder rather than cellulitis. Unremarkable peripheral flow cytometry and absent lymphatic obstruction do not exclude tissue lymphoma.
